system.description: Somewhere in your past, you accomplished a great feat of Nosferatu cunning, turning you into an immortal legend — perhaps you stole the Pope's miter, or convinced a Lasombra lord he possessed a reflection that looked just like you. Regardless, your one exploit has marked you in the annals of clan history, and it's unlikely the legend will die during your existence. You gain a bonus in social interactions with other Nosferatu who recognize the tale (reputation, favors, and the like). Unfortunately, all your other actions and exploits are measured against this one great accomplishment; nothing you do can equal that one moment of greatness, and younger Nosferatu are constantly competing to outdo you.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis IV: Thieves in the Night, Book Two: Lepers
